nome_jp: ナインエッジ・夜叉・ドラゴン
testo:
■ When you put this creature into the battle zone, search your deck. For each of your Dragons in the battle zone you may put a non-evolution cross gear that costs 3 or less into the battle zone, and cross it with that Dragon. Then shuffle your deck.
